chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Salih ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Hafs, from 'Abd Allah ibn Talhah, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

If the old man and the old woman commit zina, they are flogged and then stoned as a punishment for them. If the middle-aged man commits zina, he is stoned and not flogged, if he has been muhsan. And if the young man of tender age commits zina, he is flogged and banished for a year from his city.

key_terms.أُحْصِنَ: had become muhsan, meaning legally protected through marriage
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina, meaning unlawful sexual intercourse

ai.seo_question: What punishments for zina are mentioned in Tahdhib al-Ahkam for different categories of offenders?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out legal rulings concerning the hadd punishments for zina according to differing conditions and categories of offenders. It distinguishes between the elderly, the middle-aged muhsan man, and the young man, specifying flogging, stoning, and exile in different cases.
